pages.text: A distillation tower splits crude oil or heavy oil into several fluids at once. It is made of four things:

$(li)a $(item)Steel Fluid Tank$(), filled with the oil to split,$(li)a $(item)Steel Distillation Controller$() on the side of that tank,$(li)$(item)Steel Distillation Outputs$() stacked above the controller, with one $(item)Industrial Pipe$() between each pair,$(li)$(item)heat$() under the tank.
The tower shown here runs the full crude oil recipe: a 2 x 2 tank 12 blocks tall, the controller on its north face, six outputs and five pipes above it, and a 2 x 2 firebox underneath.

Oil goes into the steel tank like any Create fluid tank. The controller draws it from the tank block right behind it into its own 8000 mB tank, and each output collects one product in its own 8000 mB tank. Pump the products out of the outputs from any side.
A tank takes only $(item)one$() controller: a second one will not stay on a tank that already has one.
